# PaperPilot Tools — buyer-focused technical services

> AI-assisted original software from one actual economic owner. This site is a free public guide, not an instant payment gateway. Prices are conditional offers until a real buyer agrees to their terms.

## Free public examples
- [Free local CSV checker](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/csv-quality-api.html#local-preview): runs inside your browser, up to 32 KiB UTF-8, no upload, login or payment. Structural warnings, not proof of correct accounting or safety.
- [Free synthetic merchant example](https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-sample): GET, fictional data, no purchase.
- [Korean freelance estimate guide](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/freelance-estimate-ko.html): illustrative calculation, not a certified tax invoice.

## Optional paid APIs
- [VM5 CSV preflight buyer instructions](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/csv-quality-api.html): POST https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-preflight, currently 0.005 native Circle USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) per valid buyer-authorized x402 v2 request. The current unsigned valid request returns HTTP 402; malformed input returns HTTP 400 before payment. Quotes are NOT purchases. No independently verified paid POST customers at this time.
- [Original merchant public API specification](https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/docs): read current price and parameters BEFORE considering a paid request.
- [Original buyer quickstart](https://github.com/livastic-vm5-primary-20260911/x402-openapi-lint/blob/main/docs/CSV_REAL_DATA_BUYER_QUICKSTART_20261020.md): independent buyer controls signature and payment. Never send secrets or private CSV just to test a route.
- A distinct paid-and-delivered synthetic GET /v1/csv-report has previously been verified for this same-owner merchant. This does not establish any paid POST /v1/csv-preflight order.

## Custom paid work — agreement first
- [Services and technical proof](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/services.html): bilingual invoice templates (indicative from USD 99), scoped offline web utilities (from USD 249) and browser automation QA (from USD 149). These are starting quotes, not active checkouts or guaranteed delivery.
- [Manual PaperPilot offline-kit order inquiry](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/order.html): proposed 5 native Base Circle USDC for one internal-team licence. No instant checkout, no escrow, no completed PaperPilot buyers; agree actual scope, lawful payment and refund terms in writing first.
- [Opt-in customer inquiry](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/contact.html): consent-based third-party FormSubmit inquiry, not a payment order. Please do not send passwords, keys, customer files, private data, or wallet recovery phrases.

## Machine-readable public details
- [Product and offer catalog](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/catalog.json): static JSON with exact status and payment distinctions.
- [Public project source](https://github.com/livastic-vm1-primary/paperpilot-tools): code and free checker tests.

Never treat a HTTP 402 quote, catalog listing, proposal, email or previous unrelated receipt as a new payment or buyer. All service availability and API parameters are subject to provider verification.
